name: TwinFlow (few-step with target-time embedder)
plain: A few-step method where the model also knows the target timestep through a second time embedder. The pack loads extra embedder weights onto native Z-Image or Qwen-Image models and adds its own sampler. It needs a TwinFlow checkpoint.
math:
Z-Image: adaln = emb(t') + emb₂((tt'−t')·1000)·|t'−tt'|, t'=1−σ, tt'=1−σ_target. Target passes in transformer_options, read by a forward pre-hook.
Sampler (Linear transport, UCGM-S): F=(x−D)/t; x̂=D; ẑ=x+(1−t)F
x_next=(1−t_n)x̂ + t_n(ẑ√(1−r)+n√r), r=stochast_ratio.

props.hook: Extra submodule attached to dm, wrapped t_embedder, register_forward_pre_hook(dm), custom SAMPLER

label: from code
surprise: The module-level pre-hook and attribute are on the loaded DiT, not through patch API; they stay for the model's lifetime.
